headline_ne: नेपालका चार प्रतिशत सूचीकृत सेयर अझै डिम्याटबाहिर
headline_en: Four percent of Nepal's listed shares still not dematerialised
points_ne: करिब ४ प्रतिशत सूचीकृत सेयर अझै डिम्याट प्रणालीमा आएका छैनन्।
८४६.८ मिलियन सेयर इलेक्ट्रोनिक प्रणालीबाहिर रहेका छन्।
सिडिएससीका अनुसार हाल कुल २०.८७ अर्ब सेयर सूचीकृत छन्।
points_en: Nearly 4 percent of listed shares are still not dematerialised.
846.8 million shares remain outside the electronic system.
CDSC says a total of 20.87 billion shares are currently listed.
caption:
Over a decade after Demat accounts became mandatory, some shares are still outside the system.

Nearly 4 percent of shares listed on Nepal's stock market have not yet been dematerialised. That leaves 846.8 million shares outside the electronic system. CDS and Clearing (CDSC) says a total of 20.87 billion shares are currently listed.

नेपालको सेयर बजारमा सूचीकृत करिब ४ प्रतिशत सेयर अझै डिम्याट प्रणालीमा आएका छैनन्। यसले ८४६.८ मिलियन सेयरलाई इलेक्ट्रोनिक प्रणालीबाहिर राखेको छ। सिडिएससीका अनुसार हाल कुल २०.८७ अर्ब सेयर सूचीकृत छन्।

Do you think the remaining shares should be brought into Demat soon? Tell us in the comments.
